name: clear-resume
description: Write a handover when a Claude Code session gets long, type /clear, and the next session picks up where you left off with nothing to paste.

auto_nudge.title: Nudge to save a handover
auto_nudge.description: When the chat's context passes the size in Nudge at, Claude is asked once per session to save a handover. You still type /clear. A CLEAR_RESUME_AUTO line in settings.json wins over this.

nudge_at.title: Nudge at (tokens)
nudge_at.description: Context size, in tokens, that triggers the nudge. Set it above the size a new session starts at, and below the size where Claude Code compacts on its own. A CLEAR_RESUME_NUDGE_AT line in settings.json wins over this.

relay.title: Relay: clear and continue by itself
relay.description: After Claude saves a handover, clear-resume runs /clear and submits the prompt that continues from it, with no keypress. off (the default), a number of clears per Claude Code window (1, 3, 10), or unlimited. Anything else is off. This is the default for every window: type /relay off, on, unlimited or a number to change it for one window, and the status line shows the clears left. Needs Claude Code 2.1.275 or later; an older build ignores it and the rest of clear-resume works as before.
